learning_objective: 🎯 In this chapter, we will explore the massive landmasses and the deep blue waters that make up our beautiful planet Earth!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Did you know that about 71% of our Earth is covered in water, and only 29% is land? Because of so much water, Earth looks like a beautiful blue marble from space!
The huge areas of land on Earth are called continents. There are seven of them: Asia (the largest), Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia (the smallest).
The massive bodies of saltwater that surround the continents are called oceans. The five oceans are the Pacific (biggest and deepest), Atlantic, Indian, Southern, and Arctic.

fun_activity.title: 🗺️ Map Explorer Mission
fun_activity.instructions: Take a world map and a blue crayon. Color all the five oceans blue and try to find where your country is located. Which continent do you live on?

quick_recap: ⭐ Earth has 7 major landmasses called Continents and 5 huge water bodies called Oceans.
⭐ Asia is the largest continent and the Pacific is the largest ocean.
⭐ Most of the Earth's surface is covered with water, making it the Blue Planet.
